title: 50 Years Ago, This Was a Wasteland. He Changed Everything | Short Film Showcase
summary: An 8-minute National Geographic short film about David Bamberger, who bought 5,500 overgrazed acres in the Texas Hill Country and restored the land and its aquifers over about 50 years.
why: Cited in climate and water threads as an encouraging example of large-scale landscape restoration.

quote.text: National Geographic did a really good 8-minute video on it
